selection_rule: Within each calendar-year × update-type stratum, exclude any target/source DOI exposed in development, enforce globally unique target DOIs and unique event keys, rank remaining events by SHA-256 of frozen provenance identifiers, and retain the first N. inform confirmatory sample-size planning without detector-effect peeking
